paper_metadata.title: Effect of heat treatment on the microstructure and mechanical properties of Mg-Gd-Y-Zr alloys fabricated by wire arc additive manufacturing

evidence.quote: For WAAMed GW92 alloy, samples formed with GW92 wire exhibit fine microstructure and good mechanical properties due to the inheritance of the chemical composition and microstructure of the raw wire material.
